SELECT rb.redpacket_id, rb.redpacket_t_id, rb.redpacket_title, rb.redpacket_start_date, rb.redpacket_end_date, rb.redpacket_price, rb.redpacket_t_orderlimit, rb.redpacket_state, rb.redpacket_owner_id, rb.redpacket_owner_name, rt.redpacket_t_type,rb.redpacket_state FROM activity_redpacket_base rb LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_redpacket_template rt ON rb.redpacket_t_id = rt.redpacket_t_id WHERE rb.redpacket_owner_id = #{redpacketOwnerId,jdbcType=INTEGER} AND rt.redpacket_t_type = #{redpacketTType,jdbcType=INTEGER} AND rb.redpacket_state = 1 AND rt.redpacket_t_state = 1
AND (NOW() BETWEEN rb.redpacket_start_date AND rb.redpacket_end_date)
AND (NOW() BETWEEN rt.redpacket_t_start_date AND rt.redpacket_t_end_date) AND rt.redpacket_t_giveout <= rt.redpacket_t_total
group by rb.redpacket_id
